instruction: Help me save copies of all inbox emails to ~/email_copies directory. Store them as individual .eml files.

expect: 歡迎使用新的 Outlook.com 帳戶.*\.eml

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting all inbox emails to ~/email_copies folder in .eml format. Evaluator verifies that .eml files with expected email subjects are created. Uses existing check_list metric with regex patterns to match the known email subjects in the Thunderbird profile.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires saving 'ALL inbox emails', but evaluator only checks for 2 specific email subjects. If inbox contains more emails, they won't be verified.

Unverified filename assumption: Evaluator assumes .eml filenames will contain email subject text (e.g., '歡迎使用新的 Outlook.com 帳戶.eml'), but Thunderbird export may use different naming conventions (sanitized, truncated, or encoded subjects).
No completeness validation: Evaluator doesn't verify that the total count of exported .eml files matches the actual inbox email count.
Missing existence check: Doesn't verify that ~/email_copies directory was actually created before checking its contents.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add verification for total email count: Use a getter to count emails in Thunderbird inbox, then verify the same number of .eml files exist in ~/email_copies.
Update expected patterns to match actual Thunderbird export filename format: Test how Thunderbird names exported .eml files and adjust regex patterns accordingly.
Add directory existence check: Verify ~/email_copies directory exists and contains at least the expected minimum number of .eml files.
Consider using a metric that validates .eml file format: Check that exported files are valid .eml format, not just filename patterns.
